build_vit_base_model: build a VisionTransformer base model with 768 embed dim and 12 heads using vit_base
build_vit_small_model: build a VisionTransformer small model with 384 embed dim and 6 heads using vit_small
get_last_selfattention: get the last layer self-attention weights from a VisionTransformer model using get_last_selfattention
get_intermediate_layers: get intermediate layer output tokens from the last n blocks of a VisionTransformer
build_dino_head: build a DINOHead projection head with MLP layers and weight-normalized last layer for contrastive learning
